title: Special Topics in Dance; Intro to Improvisational Techniques
description: In this course we will rigorously investigate improvisational scores from music, theatre and dance. This cross disciplinary course will provide entry points into improvisation that can be utilized for everyday or the stage. We will dive into Sound Painting, Yes, and..., Sonic Mediations, Dance Exchange Toolbox, Viewpoints, and many more. Come open to discover your ability to improvise.
